by: companies-2 session, step 5.5 (proposed; appended by the integrator at the merge)
title: The NZBN register's entity detail for one entity of any kind (company, sole trader, partnership, trust, society), as the interface answered one call

landmarks: a JSON object with nzbn, entityTypeCode, entityStatusDescription, registrationDate, lastUpdatedDate, sourceRegister
roles: a list with roleType, roleStatus, startDate, endDate, uniqueIdentifier, rolePerson or roleEntity; company-details.shareholding with shareAllocation and historicShareholder (vacationDate)

signals_note: GET https://api.business.govt.nz/gateway/nzbn/v5/entities/{nzbn} with our own subscription key, through the fetch gate, one call at a time; the bytes landed verbatim by hash. Stamps are New Zealand local (2018-06-25T08:30:43.000+1200): the day is the first ten characters.
notes: Read: the entity (name, which the register may withhold for a sole trader; status; type; dates), every role, every current and historic holding, and a company's or society's REGISTERED address. Every other address (a role's, a holder's, every address of a sole trader, partnership or trust) goes to companies_private.lookup_addresses and nowhere else. E-mail addresses and telephone numbers stay in the document and are never read.
applies_to: any entity on the NZBN register a product asks about or watches, from 21 October 2026
process: Compare each answer with the state held before it (the previous answer, else the monthly file's current rows): name, status, a director present or ended, a holding started or ended, the registered office.
Date a change by the interface's own date where it states one (a role's endDate, a holding's vacationDate, an office's startDate), else by the day it was seen.
gates: Every role is a row or a catch-log line.
No address other than a company's or society's registered office is a published column.
